name: Night Watch
author: Dandyhorse
description: Keep the lighthouse lamp bright through the night. Ships come in on a timetable; below the target pace the lamp dims and they drift toward the rocks. Tap the horn to pull them back and answer their signals.

safe-harbour.name: Safe harbour
safe-harbour.description: Brought a ship home with three stars.

perfect-night.name: Perfect watch
perfect-night.description: Every ship home with three stars.

big-one.name: The big one
big-one.description: Brought the ocean liner home with three stars.

storm-keeper.name: Storm keeper
storm-keeper.description: Three stars for a ship that came in through a storm.

all-hands.name: All hands
all-hands.description: Answered every hail in a night.

steady-hand.name: Steady hand
steady-hand.description: A whole night without the horn, and no ship aground.

full-watch.name: Until dawn
full-watch.description: Kept watch to the end of the workout.

variants.name: Night Watch
variants.description: Your power keeps the lamp lit; the harbour board tells you when to push.

variants.name: Night Watch
variants.description: Your pace keeps the lamp lit; the game never touches the belt.

difficulty.label: Ships
difficulty.description: How bright the ships need the lamp, compared with your steady pace.

weather.label: Weather
weather.description: Mist only, a bit of everything, or fog and storms.
